feature_contract.goal: Preserve original +TIME sprites and numeric glyph batches through transient D3DX failed Begin/Draw while keeping exact queued and direct HUD submission ownership and native fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Original six +TIME producers, exact ID3DXSprite callbacks and separate GOAL regression protection; no generic Flush, no world/hud geometry, SkyGlow, R26-only, DX11 or frozen DXVK change.
trace_stages: Original six StageExtension E8 sprani and glyph calls select StageExtensionTime ScreenHud or queue-node exact producer provenance.
D3DX ID3DXSprite Begin/Draw batches delay actual GPU rasterization until Flush/End; a failed nested Begin previously cleared valid tracked provenance despite preserving native active batch.
Under R84 R30/R33 GPU ownership and per-eye host composition, keep a still-active batch after rejected Begin and revoke untrusted ownership after failed Draw before later Flush/End.
subcomponents: Retain active homogeneous outgoing +TIME/GOAL provenance when a nested Begin is rejected without closing the existing D3DX batch.
Fail closed on failed Draw with uncertain internal GPU submission, while leaving normal Begin, batching, producer FIFO, alpha, original HRESULT and device-reset path untouched.
Add source-location-specific regression checks and destructive mutation negatives for both failure cases before exact SHA game/host/package validation.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original StageExtension E8 to direct/queue GPU D3DX Begin/Draw/Flush/End
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A failed nested Begin cannot erase a still-active original +TIME homogeneous batch before its correct semantic Flush/End, preserving original Draw output and game HRESULT.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Untrusted D3DX draw submission and GOAL/rank/game/native fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A failed Draw revokes stale tracked +TIME/GOAL GPU batch promotion, while ordinary Draw, unrelated queue, legacy rank and original D3DX game error propagation stay unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 game x86, R26_SAFE rollback, host x64, HUD/Full Source and Domain gates
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Changed-area source mutation assertions and final exact-SHA Windows Active, Domain, HUD and Full Source gates pass before BUILD_VERIFIED; HMD separately untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: VRProjectedD3DXSpriteIsolationR64::BeginDest always called ForgetBatch and set BatchActive=SUCCEEDED(hr), even when a failed nested Begin did not close the previously active original ID3DXSprite batching session.
diagnosis.root_cause: An unsuccessful nested Begin was wrongly treated as a successful transition to a new batch, deleting StageExtensionTime/GOAL source provenance. Failed Draw similarly lacked an explicit uncertain-batch fail-closed transition.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Preserve exact still-active tracked batch across failed nested Begin; after failed Draw on the tracked sprite, invalidate BatchActive, StageBoundaryReady and pending provenance while returning the original HRESULT. Normal batching unmodified.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: tools/verify_vr_stage_extension_d3dx_batch_owner.py tests nested Begin and failed Draw scope; two source mutation negatives reject removal of the failure guards.
diagnosis.evidence_limits: No physical Quest3/VDXR test or D3DX native failed-call injection; general +TIME optical visual outcome remains open.
source_trace: Six original extension-time sprani/print callsites enter direct ScreenHud producer scopes and queue-node tags.
The R64 ID3DXSprite Begin/Draw/Flush/End hook tracks homogeneous batch ownership across producer boundaries; error-state transitions are now safe for exact producer scope.
R84 R30/R33 consumes the ownership at real draw time for left and right GPU targets, then the x64 OpenXR host composes eye images; actual HMD acceptance remains untested.
alternatives_rejected: Do not insert per-Draw global Flush, disable stage effects, change alpha, alter optical matrix assumptions or assume failed D3DX calls submitted no triangles.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Direct+queued source semantic must survive until the physical GPU Draw consumed by R84 R30/R33 per-eye processing; failure invalidates source claims, not original game raster submission.

runtime_evidence: Quest3/VDXR and original-game D3DX fault injection not executed.
